items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Henry Williams is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Oh, we had plenty of songs on the ground.
I've heard of that. Didn't somebody else record that? Somebody made a record. Henry Williams, he took lots of our... It must have been Henry Williams. Rubberlegs.
He took lots of our music, because he worked with our show, see. I've seen that title.
